# Template: pathway
A signaling or metabolic pathway diagram parsed from a kit.parseEdgeList string: nodes (protein ellipses, gene rectangles, metabolite circles, or plain-text processes) laid out left-to-right by dependency layer, connected by arrows that activate (->), bars that inhibit (-|), or dashed arrows that convert (=>). Choose this scene for ANY request about a signaling pathway, a metabolic pathway, gene regulation, a protein activating or inhibiting another, a signal cascade (e.g. EGFR/RAS/ERK, MAPK), or a pathway diagram in general.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "edges": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "kit.parseEdgeList notation: \"EGFR -> RAS; RAS -> RAF; NF1 -| RAS\" (-> activates, -| inhibits, => converts). Default: the EGFR → RAS → RAF → MEK → ERK growth-signal cascade."
  },
  "node_types": {
   "type": "object",
   "additionalProperties": {
    "type": "string",
    "enum": [
     "protein",
     "gene",
     "metabolite",
     "process"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Maps a node name to its shape: protein = rounded ellipse (default for any node not listed here), gene = rectangle, metabolite = small circle, process = plain text with no shape."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- node_<slug>: a node's shape (ellipse/rect/circle; absent for "process" nodes, which have no shape)
- node_label_<slug>: the node's name, inside its shape (above a metabolite's small circle when longer than four letters); drawn with its node
- edge_<i>: the i-th parsed edge's connector (arrow, bar, or dashed arrow)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "How does a growth signal travel from EGFR to ERK, and what switches it off?" → params: {"edges":"EGFR -> RAS; RAS -> RAF; RAF -> MEK; MEK -> ERK; NF1 -| RAS"}
Request: "Draw a metabolic pathway converting glucose to pyruvate, activated by insulin." → params: {"edges":"insulin -> glycolysis; glucose => pyruvate","node_types":{"glucose":"metabolite","pyruvate":"metabolite","insulin":"protein","glycolysis":"process"}}

In YAML: `template: pathway` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
